name: Santa Ana Assessor Parcels
note: Primary parcel universe. 57926 parcels with geometry. Lot area computed from polygon geometry (turf.area, ft²). MailAddress never requested; no owner names. APN formats seen: 999-999-99 and 999-99-999 (condos); joined to other sources after stripping non-digits. "underused" = ImprovedVal < 25% of LandVal when both present and LandVal > 0.

name: Santa Ana Zoning Classifications
note: Local zoning by Spatial joins are point-in-polygon on the parcel centroid (turf.centroid; pointOnFeature when the centroid falls outside an irregular lot). Codes mapped to ZoneCategory in scripts/data/cities.mjs; Specific Development (SD*) zones fall back to SCAG ZN24_SCAG, then SCAG general plan GP24_CITY.

name: SCAG 2024 Zoning by parcel (Orange County)
note: Filtered CITY='Santa Ana'; attributes only, joined by APN. Fallback zone category for SD* zones and for parcels outside local zoning polygons.

name: SCAG 2024 Existing Land Use by parcel (Orange County)
note: Filtered CITY='Santa Ana'; attributes only, joined by APN. vacant flag = LU24 1900 (urban vacant), 3xxx (vacant) or 1247 (public parking facilities). worship bit also set for LU24 = 1245 (179 parcels, 32 also in OSM); the label "Religious Facilities" for 1245 is from the SCAG land-use legend as recalled, not confirmed against the service (which publishes no code labels) — unverified label. Condo APNs (999-99-999) are not in SCAG, so they have no existing use.

name: SCAG 2024 General Plan Land Use by parcel (Orange County)
note: Filtered CITY='Santa Ana'; attributes only, joined by APN.

name: SCAG Housing Element Sites (6th cycle)
note: Fetched 408 features intersecting the Santa Ana bbox, but none have Jurisdiction=SANTA ANA (present: GARDEN GROVE, FOUNTAIN VALLEY, IRVINE) and none match a Santa Ana APN. The layer does not cover Santa Ana; the Housing Element test is unknown.

name: HCD Surplus Land Act Notices of Availability
note: CSV resource: https://publish.data.ca.gov/dataset/0a52a6d9-4c1f-4905-8d25-6117c60c35c8/resource/bb81599a-e130-48aa-a6e3-bbcce9392d4f/download/noa_information.csv (statewide, ~6369 lines incl. multi-line cells); filtered to Santa Ana in build. 91 Santa Ana rows of 3112; matched by APN 62, by notice x/y point-in-parcel 27, unmatched 2. Sizes like "9,005 SF" converted to acres. Contacts are public-agency staff as published in the notice.

name: OpenStreetMap places of worship (amenity=place_of_worship)
note: Overpass bbox query via https://overpass-api.de/api/interpreter: [out:json][timeout:90];nwr["amenity"="place_of_worship"](33.69,-117.948,33.785,-117.828);out geom tags; 52/85 OSM elements matched to 58 parcels (node in parcel; way: parcel containing the way centroid plus parcels whose centroid is inside the way polygon). A lead (proxy), not proof of ownership. OSM coverage is incomplete. worship bit = OSM OR SCAG LU24 1245 (see scag_landuse).

name: OC Fire Hazard Severity Zones (LRA)
note: Envelope query on Santa Ana bbox. 0 fire hazard polygons intersect the city; no parcel is in a mapped zone.

name: CAL FIRE Fire Hazard Severity Zones (SRA 2007 / LRA 2011)
note: Envelope query on Santa Ana bbox, layers 0 (SRA), 1 (LRA), 2 (awaiting zoning). Cross-check: 0 polygons intersect the city.

name: OC Floodplains (FEMA DFIRM)
note: Spatial joins are point-in-polygon on the parcel centroid (turf.centroid; pointOnFeature when the centroid falls outside an irregular lot). flood_sfha = SFHA_TF='T' or FLD_ZONE starting with A or V.

name: OC Liquefaction Zones (CGS Seismic Hazard Zones)
note: Spatial joins are point-in-polygon on the parcel centroid (turf.centroid; pointOnFeature when the centroid falls outside an irregular lot). Zones of required investigation (CGS Seismic Hazard Zones).

name: CGS Landslide Zones (Seismic Hazard Zones)
note: Spatial joins are point-in-polygon on the parcel centroid (turf.centroid; pointOnFeature when the centroid falls outside an irregular lot). 0 landslide zone polygons intersect the city bbox.

name: Caltrans High Quality Transit Areas
note: Spatial joins are point-in-polygon on the parcel centroid (turf.centroid; pointOnFeature when the centroid falls outside an irregular lot). Any HQTA polygon type (hq_corridor_bus, major_stop_bus, major_stop_rail).

name: CalEnviroScreen 5.0 results (census tracts)
note: Spatial joins are point-in-polygon on the parcel centroid (turf.centroid; pointOnFeature when the centroid falls outside an irregular lot). ces_high = CIscoreP ≥ 75.

name: OC Building Footprints
note: Envelope query on Santa Ana bbox (includes some neighbours; only footprints whose centroid falls in a Santa Ana parcel are used). Coverage = sum of footprint Shape.STArea() (ft²) for footprints whose centroid falls in the parcel ÷ parcel lot area (approximation; footprints straddling lot lines count fully for one parcel; stacked condo polygons each receive the footprint). 54403/82550 footprints assigned. low_cover = coverage < 0.25. Footprint capture date unknown.

name: Commercial corridor (derived from local zoning)
note: commercial_corridor bit set when the local zone is a named corridor/arterial district (C5, SP1, SP2, CSM). Proxy only: AB 2011 street right-of-way width (70–150 ft) is NOT tested.

name: Industrial proximity (derived from local zoning + parcel polygons)
note: heavy_industry_1200 (bit 13): parcel is zoned M2 (ZONEDESC "Heavy Industrial") or its boundary is within 1,200 ft of a parcel whose centroid zone is M2 (108 parcels). adj_industrial (bit 14): boundary within 15 ft of another parcel zoned M1/M2 (2293 parcels; covers touching lots and lots split only by a lot-line gap). PROXY: SB 4 tests "a site permitted for heavy industrial use" and "more than one-third of the square footage dedicated to light industrial use"; zoning is used in place of permits/actual use. Industrial parcels outside Santa Ana are not in the parcel set and are not considered. Distances are planar (local equirectangular projection).

name: Urban perimeter share (derived, sites only)
note: urbanPerimeterPct: the site boundary is sampled every 5 m (or perimeter/400 if longer); from each sample we step outward 1–60 m and take the first other parcel hit. Neighbour is urban unless its SCAG LU24 is vacant (19xx, 3xxx), agriculture (2xxx), water (4xxx), open space (18xx) or flood channel (1437); neighbours with no LU24 use their zone category (open_space = non-urban, other/unknown = unclassified). pct = urban / (urban + non-urban) samples; samples finding no parcel within 60 m (wide freeways, city edge) or unclassified neighbours are excluded; pct is null if fewer than half the samples are classified. Streets are crossed: parcels separated only by a street are treated as adjoining (the SB 35 rule, as recalled, unverified for SB 4). urban_perimeter_ok (bit 22) = pct ≥ 75, sites.json only (0 in parcels.json).

name: CGS Alquist-Priolo Earthquake Fault Zones
note: Envelope query on the city bbox. fault_zone (bit 15): parcel centroid inside an Alquist-Priolo Earthquake Fault Zone polygon. No zone polygon intersects the city bbox, so every parcel is outside a mapped zone. Liquefaction/landslide are NOT used for this test.

name: Santa Ana historic properties (Register / survey points)
note: historic (bit 16): matched to parcels by APN (728 listings matched, 9 of them by point-in-parcel when the APN did not match). All categories (Landmark, Key, Contributive, uncategorized) count. A listing on the local register, not a determination of eligibility.

name: Santa Ana historic districts
note: historic (bit 16): parcel centroid inside a city historic district (1821 parcels). PROXY: SB 9 excludes contributing structures in a district; being inside the district boundary does not mean the structure contributes.

name: National Register of Historic Places (NPS) points
note: Envelope query on the city bbox. historic (bit 16): NRHP point inside the parcel (17 points matched).

name: National Register of Historic Places (NPS) polygons
note: Envelope query on the city bbox. historic (bit 16): parcel centroid inside an NRHP district/property polygon (1258 parcels).

name: California Register of Historical Resources (OHP)
note: OHP does not publish the California Register / Historic Resources Inventory as a public GIS service; not checked. National Register (NPS) and the city register are used instead.

name: DTSC EnviroStor cleanup sites (Public Data Export)
note: Envelope query on the city bbox (padded 300 m). hazwaste (bit 17): EnviroStor cleanup site point inside the parcel or within 50 ft of its boundary, counting only open statuses (Active, Backlog, Inactive - Needs Evaluation, Inactive - Action Required, Certified O&M - Land Use Restrictions). Closed/referred sites (No Further Action, Certified, Refer: *, No Action Required, Withdrawn) are ignored. 54 open of 205 sites in bbox; 40 matched a parcel. PROXY for the Cortese list (Gov. Code 65962.5): GeoTracker (water board) cases are not included. Staff names are not fetched.

name: SWRCB GeoTracker cleanup sites
note: No official SWRCB ArcGIS REST layer of GeoTracker cleanup sites was found (searched gispublic.waterboards.ca.gov/portalserver Geotracker folder and ArcGIS Online). Third-party copies were not used. Only the DTSC EnviroStor half of the hazardous-waste check is answered.

name: USFWS National Wetlands Inventory
note: Envelope query on the city bbox; geometry generalized to ~1 m. wetland (bit 18): parcel centroid inside any NWI polygon (all types: riverine, freshwater pond, emergent, forested/shrub, lake). NWI is not a jurisdictional delineation; riverine and lake polygons include deepwater habitat.

name: CA DOC FMMP California Important Farmland 2022
note: Envelope query on the city bbox. farmland (bit 19): parcel centroid in FMMP 2022 Prime Farmland (P) or Farmland of Statewide Importance (S). Other FMMP classes (urban D, grazing G, other X) are not counted.

name: California Protected Areas Database (CPAD) Holdings, current release (GreenInfo Network)
note: Envelope query on the city bbox. conservation (bit 20): parcel centroid in a CPAD holding. CPAD includes ordinary city parks and school fields; it is protected open space, not necessarily an NCCP or easement. Also see cced.

name: California Conservation Easement Database (CCED), CNRA
note: Envelope query on the city bbox. conservation (bit 20): parcel centroid in a CCED conservation easement. No easement intersects the city bbox.

name: Caltrans State Highway Network (SHN Odometer lines)
note: Envelope query on the city bbox padded ~300 m. freeway_500 (bit 21): any State Highway Network centerline segment within 500 ft of the parcel boundary (planar distance). Every SHN route in and around Santa Ana (I-5, SR-22, SR-55, SR-57, I-405) is a freeway; for other cities, check that SHN routes there are freeways.
